title: Major and minor arcana in tarot, explained
description: The 78 tarot cards explained: 22 major arcana for big themes and 56 minor arcana in four suits, and how each group reads in a tarot spread.

scenes.headline: Major and minor arcana in tarot, explained
scenes.caption: A tarot deck has 78 cards: 22 major arcana for big themes and 56 minor arcana for everyday life.
scenes.vo: A tarot deck has 78 cards: 22 major arcana for big themes and 56 minor arcana for everyday life.

scenes.headline: The major arcana: 22 cards
scenes.caption: The major arcana are 22 cards numbered from 0 to 21. They begin with The Fool, numbered 0, and end with The World, numbered 21.
scenes.vo: The major arcana: 22 cards. The major arcana are 22 cards numbered from 0 to 21. They begin with The Fool, numbered 0, and end with The World, numbered 21.

scenes.headline: The minor arcana: 56 cards
scenes.caption: The minor arcana are the 56 cards that look most like a regular playing deck.
scenes.vo: The minor arcana: 56 cards. The minor arcana are the 56 cards that look most like a regular playing deck.
